LESSON: LISTENING AND SPEAKING 8.1.1 STORYTELLING – FABLES

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
Strand: Strand 8
Topic 8.1: Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables, part of Strand 8 in Grade 7 INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES.

Key inquiry question: How does storytelling enhance communication? 2. Why are fables important to the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. observe picture stories of animals,

2. work with peers to collect fables (animal stories) from the community,

3. organise the collection of fables in a portfolio,

4. work collaboratively to discuss the features of animal stories (fables),

5. conduct a storytelling session to narrate animal stories,

6. watch fables from a digital device and talk about the character traits of animals,

7. discuss moral lessons learnt from the fables, 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. observe picture stories of animals,
2. work with peers to collect fables (animal stories) from the community,
3. organise the collection of fables in a portfolio,
4. work collaboratively to discuss the features of animal stories (fables),
5. conduct a storytelling session to narrate animal stories,
6. watch fables from a digital device and talk about the character traits of animals,
7. discuss moral lessons learnt from the fables, 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening and Speaking 8.1.1 Storytelling – Fables together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is achieved as the learner interacts with digital content when watching fables from a digital

device and talking about the character traits of animals.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is achieved as the learner explores new and unique ways of conducting a storytelling

session to narrate animal stories.

Values:
• Respect: This is enhanced as the learner embraces open-mindedness when discussing moral lessons from fables.

• Patriotism: This is promoted as the learner cultivates a sense of awareness in the community when working with peers

to collect fables (animal stories).

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Indigenous knowledge is enhanced as the learner watches fables from a digital device and talks about the character traits

of animals.

Link to other Learning Areas:

The learner can relate the concept of fables to their learning of narratives in English and Kiswahili.
